refnamediv.refpurpose: An interface for interactively asking the user for a password

refsect1.title: Description
refsect1.para: io.systemd.AskPassword is a Varlink interface implemented by systemd1-related components. It can be introspected and called with varlinkctl1.
An interface for interactively asking the user for a password

refsect1.title: Interface Definition
refsect1.para: The following interface definition is exposed:
refsect1.programlisting:
# An interface for interactively asking the user for a password interface io.systemd.AskPassword
# Encodes whether to provide visual feedback as the password is typed in type EchoMode( # Request that the password is prompted for without any visual feedback off, # Show the password in plaintext as it is typed in on, # Provide visual feedback as the password is typed, but mask the password plaintext masked )
# Interactively ask the user for a password, or answer from a previously cached entry method Ask( # The message to show when prompting for the password message: ?string, # The name for the kernel keyring entry used for caching keyname: ?string, # The icon name to display, following the freedesktop.org icon naming specification icon: ?string, # An recognizable id for the password prompt id: ?string, # Timeout in µs (relative, CLOCK_MONOTONIC; set to zero to only check cache and not query interactively; set to UINT64_MAX to disable relative timeout; if not set defaults to 90s) timeoutUSec: ?int, # Timeout in µs (absolute, CLOCK_MONOTONIC; if both timeoutUSec and untilUSec are specified the earlier of the two is used; set to zero to only check cache and not query interactively; leave unset or set to UINT64_MAX to disable absolute timeout) untilUSec: ?int, # Whether to accept cached passwords from the kernel keyring acceptCached: ?bool, # Whether to push acquired passwords into the kernel keyring pushCache: ?bool, # Whether to give visual feedback when typing in the password echo: ?EchoMode, # Controls whether interactive authentication (via polkit) shall be allowed. If unspecified defaults to false. allowInteractiveAuthentication: ?bool ) -> ( # List of acquired passwords. This typically contains one entry, but might contain more in case multiple passwords were previously cached. passwords: []string )
# No password available, because none was provided in the cache, and no agent was asked error NoPasswordAvailable()
# Query timeout reached, user did not provide a password in time error TimeoutReached()

refsect1.title: Examples
refsect1.para: varlinkctl introspect SERVICE io.systemd.AskPassword shows the interface definition as served by SERVICE, and varlinkctl call SERVICE io.systemd.AskPassword.Ask '{}' invokes its Ask() method.

refsect1.title: History
refsect1.para: The io.systemd.AskPassword interface was added in version 258.
Ask(), EchoMode, NoPasswordAvailable, and TimeoutReached were added in version 258.
